description: Provenance classification for every Phase 2B fixture family under tests/fixtures/metrics/. Phase 2A's own fixtures (cli_demo_bars.jsonl, phase_2a_metric_cases.json, expected_phase_2a_metric_metadata.json, fixture_metadata.json) are untouched by Phase 2B; these are new, additive files.

families.name: phase_2b_cli_demo_bars.jsonl
families.description: Eleven daily 1_DAY bars for symbol TESTB (2026-01-10..2026-01-20), each a hand-specified record normalized through the same offline market-bar normalizer Phase 1H adapters use, then serialized as one canonical Observation per line via serialization.jsonl.serialize_jsonl.

families.name: phase_2b_normalized_metric_cases.json
families.description: Six Phase 2B metric request cases (one per new metric_name) consumed by the build-market-metrics CLI command against phase_2b_cli_demo_bars.jsonl.

families.name: expected_phase_2b_metric_metadata.json
families.description: The twenty-one required Phase 2B anchor hashes (handoff section 28), each normalized_metric_result_hash()/sha256 of a NormalizedMetricResult or CLI-output byte string built directly through squeeze_core.metrics from hand-specified bars, independent of phase_2b_cli_demo_bars.jsonl except for the phase_2b_cli_output entry.
families.note: This is a Phase 2B-only anchor manifest. It is intentionally separate from tests/fixtures/compatibility/phase_1_anchor_manifest.json and tests/fixtures/metrics/expected_phase_2a_metric_metadata.json and must never be merged into either.

case_coverage_note: As in Phase 2A (see fixture_metadata.json's own case_coverage_note), the bulk of Phase 2B's required test-case matrix (handoff sections 21-26) is expressed as executable pytest cases in tests/metrics/test_relative_volume.py, test_volume_standardization.py, test_return_baselines.py, and test_return_standardization.py, each constructing its own Observation fixtures in-line via tests/metrics/conftest.py's make_bar() helper, rather than as a second, parallel set of hand-authored JSON case files. This follows the same deliberate scope decision Phase 2A already documented: duplicating ~150 cases into a second JSON-driven parametrization format would add maintenance surface, not coverage.
